responsibility: Implements the post-reload RTL compare-elimination pass for targets whose arithmetic instructions clobber flags and therefore cannot rely on earlier combine-based compare folding. It finds canonical compare instructions that feed branches or stores, tracks a bounded set of flag uses, checks whether the preceding flags-clobbering arithmetic instruction computes equivalent operands, optionally selects a more appropriate CC mode, rewrites that setter into a PARALLEL that both computes the result and sets flags, and then deletes the now-redundant standalone compare.
